_note: rpt_ layer: one data source per department, composed from the raw-layer data sources. Build each as a single tree from "root" (exactly one base table), add the calculated fields with the formulas below (field names are display captions; a duplicated column is suffixed with " (<table>.csv)" in the order the tables were added), then publish. Values were checked against the CSVs on the reference site.

rpt_samplehyperstore__billing.datasource_description: One row per invoice line (Invoice Line Id): one order line on one invoice, with its invoice (one per shipment), the credit memo lines posted against that invoice line, and product attributes.

calculated_fields.name: Revenue
calculated_fields.formula: SUM([Qty Invoiced] * [Unit Price] - [Discount Amount]) - SUM([Merchandise Credit Amount]) - SUM([Marketplace Fee Amount]) + SUM([Marketplace Fee Reversal Amount])
calculated_fields.description: Net revenue in USD: invoiced merchandise after discounts, minus merchandise credits and marketplace fees, plus fee reversals; excl. tax and shipping. Credits fall in their original invoice's dates.

calculated_fields.name: Gross Revenue
calculated_fields.description: Invoiced (= shipped) units at selling price minus allocated discounts incl. order coupons, in USD. Excludes tax, billed shipping, credits and marketplace fees.

calculated_fields.name: Units
calculated_fields.description: Units invoiced minus units credited; credits fall in their original invoice's dates. Only return memos credit units; other memo types do not reduce it.

calculated_fields.name: Orders
calculated_fields.description: Distinct orders with at least one invoice. An order shipped in parts can count in more than one period; orders never shipped have no invoice.

calculated_fields.name: Discount
calculated_fields.description: Discount in USD on invoiced units: line promotions pro-rated to invoiced units plus allocated order-level coupons. Excludes cancelled units.

calculated_fields.name: Discount Rate
calculated_fields.description: Ratio of invoiced discount to invoiced value before discount (invoiced units at unit selling price). Cancelled units are not included.

calculated_fields.name: Return Rate
calculated_fields.description: Ratio of units credited on return memos to units invoiced; credits fall in their original invoice's dates. Returns not yet credited are not counted.

calculated_fields.name: Credits
calculated_fields.description: Revenue reversed by credit memos in USD: merchandise plus shipping credits of all memo types, tax excluded. Order-level credits are spread over the lines of one invoice.

calculated_fields.name: Net Refund Cost
calculated_fields.formula: SUM([Merchandise Credit Amount] + [Shipping Credit Amount]) - SUM([Marketplace Fee Reversal Amount])
calculated_fields.description: Credits net of marketplace fees returned, in USD: merchandise plus shipping credits minus marketplace fee reversals, tax excluded.

calculated_fields.name: Marketplace Fee Rate
calculated_fields.formula: SUM([Marketplace Fee Amount]) / SUM(IF [Channel] = 'marketplace' THEN [Qty Invoiced] * [Unit Price] - [Discount Amount] END)
calculated_fields.description: Marketplace fees withheld, gross of reversals, over invoiced merchandise after discounts on marketplace invoices. The base excludes tax and shipping.

calculated_fields.name: Net Marketplace Fee Rate
calculated_fields.formula: (SUM([Marketplace Fee Amount]) - SUM([Marketplace Fee Reversal Amount])) / (SUM(IF [Channel] = 'marketplace' THEN [Qty Invoiced] * [Unit Price] - [Discount Amount] END) + SUM(IF [Channel] = 'marketplace' THEN [Shipping Billed Amount] END))
calculated_fields.description: Marketplace fees net of reversals over invoiced merchandise after discounts plus billed shipping on marketplace invoices, tax excluded. Reversals fall in their original invoice's dates.

calculated_fields.name: Shipping Billed
calculated_fields.description: Shipping charged to customers on invoices in USD, shipping tax excluded. Free-shipping invoices bill 0; shipping credits are not deducted.

calculated_fields.name: Marketplace Fees
calculated_fields.description: Marketplace fees withheld in USD on marketplace-channel invoices, gross of reversals on refunds. Invoices in other channels carry no fee.

calculated_fields.name: Sales Region (Current Map)
calculated_fields.formula: CASE [State Code] WHEN 'AK' THEN 'R-WEST' WHEN 'CA' THEN 'R-WEST' WHEN 'HI' THEN 'R-WEST' WHEN 'OR' THEN 'R-WEST' WHEN 'WA' THEN 'R-WEST' WHEN 'AZ' THEN 'R-MOUNTAIN' WHEN 'CO' THEN 'R-MOUNTAIN' WHEN 'ID' THEN 'R-MOUNTAIN' WHEN 'MT' THEN 'R-MOUNTAIN' WHEN 'NM' THEN 'R-MOUNTAIN' WHEN 'NV' THEN 'R-MOUNTAIN' WHEN 'UT' THEN 'R-MOUNTAIN' WHEN 'WY' THEN 'R-MOUNTAIN' WHEN 'IA' THEN 'R-CENTRAL' WHEN 'IL' THEN 'R-CENTRAL' WHEN 'IN' THEN 'R-CENTRAL' WHEN 'KS' THEN 'R-CENTRAL' WHEN 'MN' THEN 'R-CENTRAL' WHEN 'MO' THEN 'R-CENTRAL' WHEN 'ND' THEN 'R-CENTRAL' WHEN 'NE' THEN 'R-CENTRAL' WHEN 'SD' THEN 'R-CENTRAL' WHEN 'WI' THEN 'R-CENTRAL' WHEN 'AL' THEN 'R-SOUTH' WHEN 'AR' THEN 'R-SOUTH' WHEN 'FL' THEN 'R-SOUTH' WHEN 'GA' THEN 'R-SOUTH' WHEN 'KY' THEN 'R-SOUTH' WHEN 'LA' THEN 'R-SOUTH' WHEN 'MS' THEN 'R-SOUTH' WHEN 'NC' THEN 'R-SOUTH' WHEN 'OK' THEN 'R-SOUTH' WHEN 'SC' THEN 'R-SOUTH' WHEN 'TN' THEN 'R-SOUTH' WHEN 'TX' THEN 'R-SOUTH' WHEN 'CT' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'DC' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'DE' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'MA' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'MD' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'ME' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'MI' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'NH' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'NJ' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'NY' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'OH' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'PA' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'RI' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'VA' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'VT' THEN 'R-EAST' WHEN 'WV' THEN 'R-EAST' END
calculated_fields.description: Sales region looked up from State Code on the territory map in effect from 2025-01-01, the same map for every date. Use it to compare regions across years; Sales Region Id is the region stamped at posting. Credit memo amounts take the state of their original invoice.

rpt_samplehyperstore__sales_orders.datasource_description: One row per order line (Order Line Id): one SKU in one order, with its order (Order Id) and product attributes, in all channels.

calculated_fields.name: Revenue
calculated_fields.formula: SUM(([Qty Ordered] - [Qty Cancelled]) * ([Unit Price] - [Line Discount Amount] / [Qty Ordered])) - SUM([Order Discount Amount])
calculated_fields.description: Booked revenue in USD net of cancellations: uncancelled units at selling price minus pro-rated line discount, minus order coupons in full. Excludes tax, shipping, returns. Cancellations fall in their original order's dates.

calculated_fields.name: Revenue before Cancellations
calculated_fields.formula: SUM([Qty Ordered] * [Unit Price] - [Line Discount Amount]) - SUM([Order Discount Amount])
calculated_fields.description: Booked revenue in USD before cancellations: all ordered units at selling price minus line discounts and order coupons. Excludes tax, shipping and returns.

calculated_fields.name: Units
calculated_fields.description: Ordered units minus cancelled units, all channels; units still on backorder count. Cancellations fall in their original order's dates.

calculated_fields.name: Orders
calculated_fields.description: Distinct orders placed in all channels, including orders later fully cancelled.

calculated_fields.name: Fulfillable Orders
calculated_fields.formula: COUNTD(IF [Qty Ordered] > [Qty Cancelled] THEN [Order Id (order_lines.csv)] END)
calculated_fields.description: Distinct orders with at least one line that still has uncancelled units; orders whose every unit was cancelled are excluded.

calculated_fields.name: Price Realization
calculated_fields.formula: (SUM([Qty Ordered] * [Unit Price] - [Line Discount Amount]) - SUM([Order Discount Amount])) / SUM([Qty Ordered] * [Unit List Price])
calculated_fields.description: Ordered value (cancelled units kept) after line discounts and order coupons over list value of ordered units. Reflects channel prices (marketplace above list, b2b below).

calculated_fields.name: Discount
calculated_fields.formula: SUM([Line Discount Amount]) + SUM([Order Discount Amount])
calculated_fields.description: Promotional discount in USD: line promotions plus order coupons on ordered units, not reduced for cancellations. Excludes the list price gap and free shipping.

calculated_fields.name: Discount Rate
calculated_fields.formula: (SUM([Line Discount Amount]) + SUM([Order Discount Amount])) / SUM([Qty Ordered] * [Unit Price])
calculated_fields.description: Promotional discount (line promotions plus order coupons) over ordered value at selling price before discount. Excludes the list-to-selling price gap.

calculated_fields.name: Stock-out Cancellation Value
calculated_fields.formula: SUM(IF [Cancel Reason] = 'out_of_stock' OR [Cancel Reason] = 'backorder_timeout' THEN [Qty Cancelled] * [Unit Price] END)
calculated_fields.description: Value in USD of units cancelled for stock reasons (Cancel Reason out_of_stock or backorder_timeout), at unit selling price before line discount; other reasons excluded.

rpt_samplehyperstore__merchandising.datasource_description: One row per order line (Order Line Id): one SKU in one order, with its order (Order Id) and product attributes, in all channels.

calculated_fields.name: Demand
calculated_fields.description: Demand in USD: all ordered units, incl. units later cancelled, at Unit List Price. Selling price, promotions and coupons are ignored.

calculated_fields.name: Units
calculated_fields.description: All ordered units in all channels, including units later cancelled or backordered.

calculated_fields.name: Price Realization
calculated_fields.formula: SUM([Qty Ordered] * [Unit Price] - [Line Discount Amount]) / SUM([Qty Ordered] * [Unit List Price])
calculated_fields.description: Ordered value after line promotions over list value of ordered units, order coupons not deducted. Reflects channel prices (marketplace above list, b2b below).

calculated_fields.name: Markdown
calculated_fields.formula: SUM([Qty Ordered] * ([Unit List Price] - [Unit Price])) + SUM([Line Discount Amount]) + SUM([Order Discount Amount])
calculated_fields.description: Reduction from list in USD on ordered units: list-to-selling price gap, line promotions and order coupons. Marketplace prices above list reduce it; free shipping excluded.

calculated_fields.name: Markdown Rate
calculated_fields.formula: (SUM([Qty Ordered] * ([Unit List Price] - [Unit Price])) + SUM([Line Discount Amount]) + SUM([Order Discount Amount])) / SUM([Qty Ordered] * [Unit List Price])
calculated_fields.description: Total markdown from list (price gap, line promotions, order coupons) over list value of ordered units. Marketplace prices above list reduce it.

calculated_fields.name: Net Ordered Units
calculated_fields.description: Ordered units minus cancelled units, all channels; units still on backorder count. Unlike Units, cancelled units are removed. Cancellations fall in their original order's dates.

calculated_fields.name: Order Lines
calculated_fields.description: Distinct order lines (one SKU in one order) in all channels, including lines later fully cancelled.

rpt_samplehyperstore__shipments.datasource_description: One row per shipment line (Shipment Line Id): one order line in one shipment, with its shipment (Shipment Id: one parcel group from one warehouse with one carrier) and product attributes.

calculated_fields.name: Units
calculated_fields.description: Units shipped, summed over shipment lines; unshipped and cancelled units are not included.

calculated_fields.name: On-time Rate
calculated_fields.formula: SUM(IIF([Delivered Date] <= [Promised Delivery Date], 1, 0)) / SUM(IIF(NOT ISNULL([Delivered Date]), 1, 0))
calculated_fields.description: Share of delivered shipments with Delivered Date on or before Promised Delivery Date, judged per shipment. Undelivered shipments (empty Delivered Date) are excluded.

calculated_fields.name: On-time Rate vs Carrier Estimate
calculated_fields.formula: SUM(IIF([Delivered Date] <= [Carrier Estimated Delivery Date], 1, 0)) / SUM(IIF(NOT ISNULL([Delivered Date]), 1, 0))
calculated_fields.description: Share of delivered shipments with Delivered Date on or before Carrier Estimated Delivery Date. In transit, lost and returned shipments are excluded.

calculated_fields.name: Carrier On-time Rate, All Shipments
calculated_fields.formula: SUM(IIF([Delivered Date] <= [Carrier Estimated Delivery Date], 1, 0)) / COUNTD([Shipment Id])
calculated_fields.description: Share of all shipments delivered by Carrier Estimated Delivery Date. Undelivered ones count as late: lost, returned, and still in transit.

calculated_fields.name: Perfect Order Rate
calculated_fields.formula: COUNTD(IF {FIXED [Order Id] : SUM(IIF(ISNULL([Delivered Date]) OR [Delivered Date] > [Promised Delivery Date], 1, 0))} = 0 THEN [Order Id] END) / COUNTD([Order Id])
calculated_fields.description: Share of shipped orders with every shipment delivered by Promised Delivery Date; one late or undelivered shipment makes it imperfect. Fixed on Order Id: judged on all its shipments even when filtered.

calculated_fields.name: Freight Cost
calculated_fields.description: Freight cost in USD paid to carriers for shipments. Shipping charged to customers is not netted off.

rpt_samplehyperstore__returns_refunds.datasource_description: One row per return authorization line (Return Id) and per refund payment (Refund Id), related by Return Id, with attributes of the returned SKU.

calculated_fields.name: Refunds
calculated_fields.formula: SUM([Merchandise Refund Amount] + [Tax Refund Amount] + [Shipping Refund Amount])
calculated_fields.description: Refunds issued in USD (merchandise, tax, shipping), all refund types and methods, incl. store credit and refunds without a return (empty Return Id).

calculated_fields.name: Cash Refunds
calculated_fields.formula: SUM(IF [Refund Method] <> 'store_credit' THEN [Merchandise Refund Amount] + [Tax Refund Amount] + [Shipping Refund Amount] END)
calculated_fields.description: Refunds paid out in USD to the original payment or via marketplace (merchandise, tax, shipping), store credit excluded; incl. refunds without a return.

calculated_fields.name: Cost of Returns
calculated_fields.formula: SUM([Merchandise Refund Amount] + [Shipping Refund Amount]) + SUM([Return Shipping Cost Amount])
calculated_fields.description: Refunded merchandise and shipping plus company-paid return shipping in USD, tax excluded. Refunds fall in their return's dates; refunds without a return are included but have no Requested Date.

calculated_fields.name: Days to Return Request
calculated_fields.description: Average days from Delivered Date to Requested Date per return line. Return lines without a Delivered Date are skipped.

calculated_fields.name: Days from Shipment to Return Request
calculated_fields.description: Average days from Shipped Date to Requested Date per return line: transit time plus the time the customer kept the item.

calculated_fields.name: Days from Order to Return Request
calculated_fields.description: Average days from Order Date to Requested Date per return line.

calculated_fields.name: Requested Units
calculated_fields.description: Units customers asked to return, summed over return lines of every status, including rejected returns and items never received.

calculated_fields.name: Received Units
calculated_fields.description: Units received back at the warehouse, summed over return lines; lines not received count 0.

calculated_fields.name: Returned Order Lines
calculated_fields.description: Distinct order lines with a return line (Order Line Id of the return).

rpt_samplehyperstore__web_analytics.datasource_description: One row per web or app session (Session Id), related to the on-site searches run in it (Search Id, one row per search).

calculated_fields.name: Revenue
calculated_fields.description: Analytics-tool purchase value in USD at checkout, web and app sessions only: merchandise after discounts, shipping and tax. Not reduced by cancellations or returns.

calculated_fields.name: Transactions
calculated_fields.description: Distinct orders completed in a web or app session; marketplace and b2b orders have no session and are not counted.

calculated_fields.name: No-results Rate
calculated_fields.description: Share of searches matching no active product (Results Count = 0). Searches whose matches are all out of stock stay in the denominator but not the numerator.

calculated_fields.name: Out-of-stock Results Rate
calculated_fields.formula: SUM(IIF([Results In Stock Count] = 0, 1, 0)) / COUNTD([Search Id])
calculated_fields.description: Share of searches with nothing shown in stock at the visitor's serving warehouse (Results In Stock Count = 0), incl. searches with no results.

calculated_fields.name: No-click Rate
calculated_fields.description: Share of searches where no result was clicked (empty Clicked Product Id).

calculated_fields.name: Out-of-stock View Share
calculated_fields.description: Ratio of product page views shown as out of stock for the visitor's serving warehouse to all product page views. Counts views, so reloads count again.

calculated_fields.name: Out-of-stock Sessions without Order
calculated_fields.formula: COUNTD(IF [Oos Product Views] > 0 AND ISNULL([Order Id]) THEN [Session Id] END)
calculated_fields.description: Count of sessions with at least one out-of-stock product view and no order; a count of sessions, not of lost units.

calculated_fields.name: Sessions
calculated_fields.description: Distinct web and app sessions, with or without an order. Marketplace and b2b orders have no session.

calculated_fields.name: Units Added to Cart
calculated_fields.description: Units added to the cart in web and app sessions. Sessions without a cart add count 0 and have no Cart Added Date.
